flows.title: Edison Township Residential Construction & Zoning Permit Workflow
flows.description: Official step-by-step decision tree for residential construction, additions, decks, pools, sheds, and fences based on the Edison Township Zoning Permit Requirement Sheet and Ordinance O.2158.

step_scope_selection.title: Step 1 of 3: Scope of Proposed Residential Construction
step_scope_selection.message: Welcome to the Edison Township Zoning & Engineering procedural guide. Under Township Code Chapter 39, what is the primary scope of your proposed construction or property improvement?
step_scope_selection.help_text: Every exterior structural change, addition, accessory building, or ground disturbance requires verified zoning compliance before building permits can be issued.

options.label: New Single-Family Dwelling Construction
options.description: Ground-up new home construction ($200.00 review fee)

options.label: Residential Addition / Structural Alteration
options.description: Expanding dwelling footprint, second story, or structural extension ($100.00 fee)

options.label: Unenclosed Deck, Porch, or Patio
options.description: Attached or detached residential deck construction ($75.00 fee)

options.label: Swimming Pool (In-Ground or Above-Ground)
options.description: Above-ground pool ($75.00) or In-ground pool ($150.00) including barrier enclosure

options.label: Storage Shed, Detached Garage, or Fence (> 6 ft)
options.description: Accessory shed ($50-$100) or residential fence ($50.00)

step_survey_verification.title: Step 2 of 3: Property Survey Requirement Check
step_survey_verification.message: Under official Edison Zoning Permit Application Requirements (Item B), you must submit three (3) copies of a current property survey prepared by a NJ licensed land surveyor (drawn to scale: 1" = 20' or 1" = 30') showing exact property lines and the proposed structure footprint. Do you possess this survey?
step_survey_verification.help_text: Mortgage surveys or hand-drawn sketches not drawn to scale are rejected at intake per Township protocol.

options.label: Yes, I have 3 copies of a signed & sealed survey to scale
options.description: Prepared by a NJ licensed land surveyor (1"=20' or 1"=30')

options.label: No / Survey needs to be ordered or located
options.description: Need assistance understanding survey requirements

explain_survey_protocol.title: Property Survey Requirement Guidance
explain_survey_protocol.message: Edison Township strictly requires a certified survey before any zoning permit can be processed. You can check if a prior sealed survey is on file with the Division of Zoning at (732) 248-7230, or commission an updated survey from a licensed New Jersey Land Surveyor. Once ready, confirm below.

options.label: I have located / arranged the certified survey
options.description: Proceed to setback and lot coverage verification

options.label: Save requirements and return later
options.description: Download requirement sheet first

step_setback_compliance.title: Step 3 of 3: Setback & Lot Coverage Compliance
step_setback_compliance.message: Does your proposed structure maintain the required yard buffers under Edison Township Zoning Code? For decks: minimum 15-foot rear yard setback required. For pools: minimum rear/side setbacks and 4-foot self-closing barrier fence required. Total lot impervious coverage must not exceed zoning limits.
step_setback_compliance.help_text: Structures encroaching into setback buffers require a formal Land Use Variance from the Zoning Board of Adjustment before a permit can be issued.

options.label: Yes, Proposed construction conforms to all setback buffers
options.description: All dimensions fit within the legal building envelope

options.label: No / Encroaches into setback buffer (Variance Needed)
options.description: Will require a Land Use Variance from Zoning Board of Adjustment

route_to_land_use_variance.title: Zoning Board of Adjustment Variance Required
route_to_land_use_variance.message: Because the proposed improvement encroaches into municipal setback buffers or exceeds maximum lot coverage, the Division of Zoning cannot issue a standard administrative permit. You must file a formal Land Use Variance Application with the Zoning Board of Adjustment.
route_to_land_use_variance.alternative_action: Download the official Land Use Variance Application from the Document Center and contact the Zoning Board Secretary at (732) 248-7230 to schedule a hearing on the 2nd or 4th Tuesday of the month.

options.label: Adjust plans to conform to setback buffers
options.description: Modify dimensions to stay within legal setbacks

issue_edison_zoning_packet.title: Official Edison Township Zoning Permit Application Issued
issue_edison_zoning_packet.message: Zoning prerequisites verified. Download the official, authentic Edison Township Zoning Permit Application packet below. Please review the checklist of attachments and follow the municipal intake submission instructions.
issue_edison_zoning_packet.form_title: Official Edison Township Zoning Permit Application Form
issue_edison_zoning_packet.fill_in_instructions:
1. Complete all applicant, owner, and work site details (Block, Lot, Street Address).
2. Application MUST be signed by BOTH the applicant and the deed property owner.
3. Briefly describe the work being conducted in Section #5.
4. Attach three (3) copies of your property survey with proposed improvements drawn to scale.
required_attachments: Completed and signed Edison Township Zoning Permit Application
Three (3) copies of signed & sealed property survey (scale 1"=20' or 1"=30') prepared by a NJ licensed land surveyor
Dimensioned architectural or construction sketches indicating proposed height and setbacks
For pools: Barrier fence enclosure specifications (min 4ft high with self-closing/latching gate)
Zoning review fee check payable to 'Township of Edison'

fee_info.payment_methods: Check or Money Order payable to 'Township of Edison', or in-person credit card at Zoning Desk

submission_routing.desk: Zoning Intake Desk, 2nd Floor, Edison Municipal Complex
submission_routing.hours: Monday – Friday: 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM (Daily intake cutoff: 4:00 PM)

issue_edison_zoning_packet.lead_time: 10 to 14 business days from receipt of completed application

flows.title: Edison Township Street Opening & Excavation Permit Workflow
flows.description: Procedural decision tree for pavement saw-cutting, utility trenching, sidewalk cuts, and road excavations across Edison Township municipal rights-of-way.

step_utility_811_check.title: Step 1 of 3: State 811 'Call Before You Dig' Locate Ticket
step_utility_811_check.message: Under State Underground Facilities Act and Edison Township Public Works Code, no road opening permit can be issued without an active, verified State 811 Utility Locate Ticket number. Have you obtained your 811 confirmation number?
step_utility_811_check.help_text: Call 811 or visit call811.com at least 3 business days prior to planned excavation.

options.label: Yes, Active 811 Dig Ticket Confirmation Received
options.description: Hold valid utility locate confirmation reference

options.label: No / 811 Ticket Not Yet Filed
options.description: Must file utility locate before road permit can be accepted

disqualify_no_811.title: Mandatory Prerequisite: 811 Utility Locate Required
disqualify_no_811.message: Public safety statutes strictly prohibit municipal excavation permit issuance without verified underground utility markings (gas, electric, water, telecom).
disqualify_no_811.alternative_action: Call 811 or submit online at call811.com. Once your confirmation ticket is issued, return to resume this permit request.

options.label: I have now obtained my 811 ticket number
options.description: Resume excavation permit workflow

step_traffic_impact_check.title: Step 2 of 3: Roadway Traffic Obstruction Review
step_traffic_impact_check.message: Will your excavation, trenching, or construction equipment obstruct or close any travel lane, bicycle path, or pedestrian sidewalk in Edison Township?

options.label: Yes, Travel Lane or Sidewalk Will Be Obstructed
options.description: Requires Edison Police Traffic Division detour review and certified flaggers

options.label: No, Confined to Curb Verge / Off-Travel Shoulder
options.description: Standard safety cones and barricades sufficient

step_restoration_bond_check.title: Step 3 of 3: Pavement Restoration Bond Agreement
step_restoration_bond_check.message: Township regulations require a refundable $5,000.00 pavement restoration guarantee bond (or certified check) to guarantee road surface repaving and 12-month asphalt settlement stability. Are you prepared to post this bond?

options.label: Yes, Bond or Certified Check Ready
options.description: Applicant is prepared to furnish the $5,000 restoration guarantee

options.label: Need Information on Bond Return Protocols
options.description: Held until final 12-month post-restoration settlement inspection

issue_road_opening_packet.title: Official Edison Street Opening Application Form Issued
issue_road_opening_packet.message: Excavation prerequisites verified. Download the official, authentic Edison Township Street Opening Application below and review the submission instructions.
issue_road_opening_packet.form_title: Official Edison Township Street Opening Application Form
issue_road_opening_packet.fill_in_instructions:
1. Provide contractor business name, emergency 24/7 phone, and active 811 Dig Ticket #.
2. Detail trench route and cut dimensions (length, width, depth).
3. Attach Certificate of Liability Insurance ($1,000,000 general liability naming Township of Edison).
4. Submit to Department of Public Works intake desk.
required_attachments: Completed Edison Township Street Opening Application
Active State 811 Utility Locate Ticket confirmation number
Trench route dimension sketch and pavement saw-cut specification
Pavement restoration bond ($5,000.00 certified check or surety bond)
Certificate of Contractor Insurance naming Township of Edison

fee_info.amount: $150.00 filing fee + $5,000.00 refundable restoration guarantee bond
fee_info.payment_methods: Certified Bank Check for restoration deposit; Company check for filing fee

submission_routing.department: Edison Township Department of Public Works / Engineering
submission_routing.desk: Public Works & Engineering Desk, Edison Municipal Complex

issue_road_opening_packet.lead_time: 5 to 7 business days from receipt of bond and application

flows.title: Township of Edison Tree Removal Permit Decision Workflow
flows.description: Official step-by-step decision tree under the Township of Edison Permit Flow Charts (Page 3) to determine whether a tree removal permit is required, emergency hazard protocols, and concurrent filing procedures.

step_removing_trees_check.title: Tree Removal Inquiry: Step 1 of 2
step_removing_trees_check.message:
I can help you understand the Township of Edison's tree-removal requirements.

First, are you planning to remove one or more trees?

options.label: Yes, I am planning to remove one or more trees
options.description: Proceed to emergency condition evaluation

options.label: No, I am not removing any trees
options.description: Check if project involves a subdivision or demolition permit

step_emergency_check.title: Emergency & Hazard Check: Step 2
step_emergency_check.message: Is this an emergency situation where the tree is dead, dying, or poses an immediate danger?

options.label: Yes, it is an emergency (dead, dying, or imminent danger)
options.description: Emergency protocol under Edison Permit Flow Chart

options.label: No, it is a planned removal of a healthy tree
options.description: Standard tree removal permit requirement

step_subdivision_demolition_check.title: Subdivision or Demolition Check: Step 2
step_subdivision_demolition_check.message: Is this application part of a subdivision or does it require a demolition permit from Code Enforcement?

options.label: Yes, part of a subdivision or requires demolition permit
options.description: Permit required under municipal flowchart

options.label: No, not part of a subdivision or demolition permit
options.description: Permit is not required under municipal flowchart

step_emergency_protocol_result.title: Emergency Tree Removal Protocol
step_emergency_protocol_result.message:
According to the official **Township of Edison Permit Flow Charts** (Page 3):

1. **Take Documentation Proof**: Take photographic proof OR obtain a certified letter from a licensed arborist/forester stating that the tree is dead/dying and is an imminent danger.
2. **Remove the Tree Immediately**: For safety, you are authorized to remove the tree without waiting for advance approval.
3. **Concurrent Permit Submission**: You must submit for the permit concurrent to (or immediately following) the tree removal along with your proof.

*(Note: An official standalone Tree Removal application form has not yet been verified on the official Edison Township Document Center. Please visit https://www.edisonnj.org/document_center/index.php for official updates.)*

step_planned_permit_required_result.title: Tree Removal Permit Required
step_planned_permit_required_result.message:
According to the official **Township of Edison Permit Flow Charts** (Page 3):

• **A Tree Removal Permit is REQUIRED** before removing the tree.

*(Note: An official standalone Tree Removal application form has not yet been verified on the official Edison Township Document Center. Please visit https://www.edisonnj.org/document_center/index.php for official updates.)*

step_subdivision_permit_required_result.title: Tree Removal Permit Required (Subdivision / Demolition)
step_subdivision_permit_required_result.message:
According to the official **Township of Edison Permit Flow Charts** (Page 3):

• Because this project is part of a subdivision or requires a demolition permit from Code Enforcement, **a Tree Removal Permit is REQUIRED**.

*(Note: An official standalone Tree Removal application form has not yet been verified on the official Edison Township Document Center. Please visit https://www.edisonnj.org/document_center/index.php for official updates.)*

step_permit_not_required_result.title: Tree Removal Permit NOT Required
step_permit_not_required_result.message:
According to the official **Township of Edison Permit Flow Charts** (Page 3):

• Because you are not removing trees and your project is not part of a subdivision or demolition permit from Code Enforcement, **a Tree Removal Permit is NOT required**.

flows.title: Edison Township Sewer Connection Allocation Workflow
flows.description: Procedural guidance and form issuance for connecting to the Edison Township municipal sanitary sewer system.

step_sewer_type.title: Step 1 of 2: Sewer Connection Scope
step_sewer_type.message: Welcome to the Edison Township Sewer Utility review. What is the scope of your sewer connection request?

options.label: New Single-Family Dwelling Sewer Tap-In
options.description: Connecting a newly constructed residence to municipal main

options.label: Residential Addition / Commercial Facility Upgrade
options.description: Adding bathrooms, commercial kitchens, or high-volume fixtures

step_sewer_fixture_count.title: Step 2 of 2: Plumbing Fixture Unit Count
step_sewer_fixture_count.message: Sewer connection fees in Edison Township are calculated based on the total number of proposed plumbing fixture units (water closets, sinks, showers, laundry tubs). Do you have your plumbing isometric schematic ready?

options.label: Yes, Plumbing isometric plans and fixture count ready
options.description: Plumber or architect has itemized all water fixtures

options.label: Need Sewer Application and Fixture Table
options.description: Download application and fixture calculation sheet

issue_sewer_packet.title: Official Edison Sewer Connection Application Issued
issue_sewer_packet.message: Download the official Edison Township Sewer Connection Charge Application below. Complete the fixture unit calculations and submit to the Sewer Utility Division.
issue_sewer_packet.form_title: Official Edison Township Sewer Connection Charge Application
issue_sewer_packet.fill_in_instructions:
1. Fill in applicant, owner, and parcel identification (Block, Lot, Street Address).
2. Complete the plumbing fixture unit table.
3. Attach civil site utility connection plan.
4. Submit to Edison Sewer Utility Division, 100 Municipal Blvd.
required_attachments: Utility site plan showing proposed sanitary lateral connection to main sewer line

fee_info.amount: Calculated by plumbing fixture unit schedule per Edison Municipal Code

submission_routing.desk: Sewer Utility Desk, Edison Municipal Complex

issue_sewer_packet.lead_time: 10 to 14 business days for capacity allocation review
